person_updates.identity_evidence: The visually checked index gives Frank L Coursen Jr in Box 148 with a private identifier. The complete Army merged file contains no exact identifier or exact-name row, and official, institutional, newspaper, obituary, directory and web checks produced no reliable OSS or pre-OSS bridge.
person_updates.next_action: No reliable pre-OSS employer has yet been identified in the accessible sources reviewed. Review Box 148 and the original identifier-bearing record; the Army-file non-hit is not negative proof.

person_updates.identity_evidence: The visually checked Box 148 row prints Courtlandt in the last-name column and Canby in the first-name column, yielding Canby Courtlandt. The same official index separately lists Courtlandt Canby in Box 104, and a person-specific obituary confirms that arrangement and OSS service. The transposition strongly suggests a duplicate or cross-reference, but separate boxes require direct file comparison.
person_updates.next_action: Compare the Box 148 file with the separate Box 104 Courtlandt Canby file before linking or merging the entities. Do not transfer the obituary or any affiliation to this transposed row until the files confirm duplication.
